## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `make validate`.
- [ ] I inspected affected animations at normal display size (and ~64 px).
- [ ] I ran `make docs` (strict) if I touched `docs/`, `mkdocs.yml`, or `overrides/`, and links resolve.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` for a user-visible change.
- [ ] Docs copy follows the style guide in `CONTRIBUTING.md`: playful, never manipulative; status words (live / on each release / planned) are accurate; the unofficial notice is present or linked where the name or likeness appears.
- [ ] I have the right to submit every asset under the MIT License.
- [ ] I included no credentials, private data, local absolute paths, or cache IDs.

## Visual evidence

Add before/after images or previews when applicable.
